data.intent: Pure motion library: accel-limited kinematics, multi-waypoint cuts, non-naive defender pursuit, animated disc flight. Transient state; no Scene or format change.
Pure kinematics: Mover/MotionState types, motion tunables, Vec2 math, accel-limited arrive() with braking, multi-waypoint route sequencing, purity guard test

data.summary: Pure kinematics: types, constants, vec, arrive() with emergent turn cost, waypoint routes, 4-way mutation-tested motionGuard. 49 new tests, 683 total, tsc clean.
data.canon_entry: motion/ is a pure library mirroring space/; turn cost is emergent from vector accel-limiting, not a rule; vmax/react/flightTime are never redeclared (ADR-3).
data.notes_for_evaluator: coast() added beyond task list; motionGuard grew determinism + inlined-constant scans; task 10 shipped as three tests plus a straight-line control.

data.intent: Cushion pursuit model on a reaction delay, step() as the single physics entry point, headless simulate() producing a Trajectory

data.summary: Cushion pursuit on a reaction delay, step(), headless simulate() with live/headless agreement. 36 new tests, 719 total.
data.canon_entry: ADR-2 amended: cushion is fixed, a lead term scales with cutter speed. step() consumes its input state (ring written in place); simulate() clones.
data.notes_for_evaluator: lead is a 4th MotionParams tunable added mid-partition and signalled; task 26 metric became separation gained on the final leg; defaults leave a defender level after a deep sprint from standstill - flagged for by-eye review.

data.intent: Fixed-timestep accumulator driving step() off rAF, writing through store.mutate; transient motion mode state; run/stop/reset; reduced-motion path

data.summary: Fixed-timestep accumulator driving step() off rAF, one mutate per rendered frame, run/stop/reset, reduced-motion path. 19 new tests, 738 total. Perf: full frame 9.57ms of 16ms.
data.canon_entry: ADR-5 driver is the only wall-clock reader in fieldview/; clamp is per-frame so a stall costs time rather than fast-forwarding; motionMode is a singleton while drivers are per-store.
data.notes_for_evaluator: Injected clock/scheduler seam added for testability; page-level Profiler assertion deferred to P4 as task 68; package.json edited to add motionBench to test:perf.

data.intent: Route section in the offense panel, destination picking and draggable markers in FieldCanvas, routeLayer, Movement sliders, motion params persisted in prefs

data.summary: Route section, destination picking, draggable markers, running indicator, Movement sliders, motion params persisted. 17 new tests, 755 total.
data.canon_entry: Marker drag is imperative (DOM during drag, one commit on release) to hold ADR-2; MotionDriverProvider mounts once per page wrapping both shells.
data.notes_for_evaluator: driverContext.tsx and Whiteboard.tsx touched outside declared scope; out-of-bounds destinations changed from cancel to clamp to honour FR-2.5; shell parity left to the existing panelParity test.

data.intent: Animated disc flight timed by the space model's flightTime(); possession changes on arrival, not on click

data.summary: Animated disc flight timed by space flightTime(); possession moves on arrival. 18 new tests, 773 total.
data.canon_entry: Disc flight duration is the space model flightTime(), never recomputed; the live flight runs on its own driver loop while MotionState.disc stays the model fact for trajectories.
data.notes_for_evaluator: throwDisc returns a boolean with an instant-throw fallback; three throwing tests became async; flight position published via throwMode for pieceLayer.
